lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Yang Ling wants to visit Su Hai's new home.
lines.chinese: 杨玲想拜访苏海的新家。

lines.speaker: Yang Ling
lines.english: How do I get to your home, Su Hai?

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: You can take the metro. You can get on the metro at Park Station and get off at City Library Station. Then, walk to Moon Street. There's a bookshop on the street. My Home is next to it.
lines.chinese: 你可以乘地铁。你可以在公园站上地铁，在城市图书馆站下车。然后，走到月亮街。街上有一家书店。我家就在它旁边。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Yang Ling comes out of City Library Station. She is on Sun Street. She cannot find the bookshop. She asks a policeman for help.
lines.chinese: 杨玲从城市图书馆站出来。她在太阳街上。她找不到那家书店。她向一位警察求助。

lines.speaker: Yang Ling
lines.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the bookshop on Moon Street?
lines.chinese: 打扰一下，我怎么到月亮街上的那家书店？

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.english: Go along this street. Turn right at the traffic lights. Then, go along Moon Street. You can see the bookshop on your right.
lines.chinese: 沿着这条街走。在红绿灯处右转。然后，沿着月亮街走。你能看到你右边的书店。
